readme:
# Prospects.ac.uk Scraper: UK Graduate Jobs

Extract graduate schemes, graduate jobs, internships, placement years and apprenticeships from [Prospects.ac.uk](https://www.prospects.ac.uk), the UK universities' official careers-service partner. Every listing includes salary, sector, degree requirement, closing date and a direct apply URL.

## What it does

Prospects.ac.uk aggregates graduate opportunities from thousands of UK employers, from FTSE 100 grad schemes to niche placement years and postgraduate courses. This actor pulls the full search feed via the site's own JSON endpoint, then optionally fetches each listing's detail page for the description, degree requirement, closing date, visa sponsorship stance and diversity scheme flags.

Two modes:

- **Fast**: search JSON only. ~10 fields per row, sub-second per page.
- **Full**: search JSON + PDP scrape. All 24 fields including full description, visa sponsorship, diversity flags and canonical apply URL.

Both modes cover all opportunity types Prospects.ac.uk lists: graduate schemes, graduate jobs, internships, vacation placements, placement years, apprenticeships and postgraduate courses.

## Pricing

**$0.001 per actor start + $0.003 per SERP row (fast) or $0.005 per detail row (full) + optional $0.005 per unique employer profile enriched. About $3 to $5 per 1,000 graduate roles.**

You only pay for rows that successfully return data. Failed fetches are not charged.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `searchQueries` | array of strings | Graduate keywords to search for (e.g. `"graduate scheme"`, `"software developer"`, `"consulting"`). Each runs as a separate search; results are deduplicated across queries. |
| `maxResults` | integer | Total cap across all queries. Default 20. Prospects.ac.uk typically lists 300 to 2,000 open graduate roles at any time. |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Per-keyword cap. Default 100. |
| `mode` | string | `"fast"` (search JSON only) or `"full"` (search JSON plus detail pages). Default `"full"`. |
| `maxConcurrency` | integer | Concurrent detail page requests in full mode. Default 5. |

### Example input

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["graduate scheme", "internship"],
  "maxResults": 200,
  "mode": "full"
}
```

## Output fields

**Identity**
- `id`: Prospects.ac.uk job ID
- `title`: Role title
- `employer_name`: Hiring organisation

**Classification**
- `sector`: Prospects.ac.uk sector taxonomy (IT, finance, healthcare, engineering, etc)
- `employment_type`: `graduate-scheme`, `graduate-job`, `internship`, `placement-year`, `apprenticeship`, `postgrad-course`
- `workplace_type`: `remote`, `hybrid`, `onsite`
- `degree_required`: `any`, `2:2`, `2:1`, `1st`, `masters`, `phd`

**Compensation**
- `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `salary_currency`, `salary_period`, `salary_text`

**Timing**
- `start_date_type`: `immediate`, `fixed-date`, `rolling`
- `duration_months`: For fixed-term roles (internships, placements)
- `closing_date`: Application deadline (ISO 8601)
- `posted_at`: When the listing was posted
- `scheme_size`: Number of positions in the scheme when disclosed

**Description and links**
- `description`: Full plain-text description (full mode)
- `location`: City or region
- `job_url`: Canonical Prospects.ac.uk URL
- `application_url`: Direct apply link
- `source_platform`: Always `prospects.ac.uk`

**Trust and inclusion signals**
- `prospects_verified`: Prospects.ac.uk employer trust badge
- `sponsor_visa`: True if employer states visa sponsorship, false if explicitly declined, null when unstated
- `diversity_scheme_flag`: True if listing mentions Rare, 10,000 Black Interns, Bright Network or similar

**Employer profile (populated when `includeCompanyDetails=true`)**
- `company_about`: About-us text from the employer's `/employer-profiles/{slug}-{id}` page
- `company_phone`, `company_email`: Contact details when the employer publishes them (usually null on Prospects)
- `company_website`: Redirect URL to the employer's own site
- `company_address_street`, `company_address_city`, `company_address_postcode`, `company_address_country`: Employer postal address
- `company_active_jobs_count`: Total open roles at this employer (from the search API)
- `company_active_jobs`: Additional roles at the same employer. Prospects does not list these on the employer profile so the array is usually empty.

## Why this scraper

- **Source-of-truth for UK graduate hiring.** Prospects.ac.uk is Jisc's official careers portal, the one nearly every UK university links from its careers service.
- **24 fields per row.** Includes the ones grad-hiring workflows actually need: degree class, closing date, sponsorship stance, diversity scheme flags.
- **Zero login, zero captcha subscriptions.** HTTP-only, uses the site's own JSON search endpoint plus its SSR detail pages.
- **Pay-per-row.** No hourly rental. Small runs cost cents.

## Common use cases

- **Graduate recruitment agencies**: Track competitor grad schemes and salary benchmarks by sector.
- **University careers services**: Feed a live list of relevant roles to your careers portal.
- **AI job-search agents**: Give agents structured access to the UK's biggest graduate feed.
- **Diversity and inclusion research**: Track how many UK grad schemes flag diversity partnerships year over year.

## Notes and limits

- Prospects.ac.uk's search API caps at 20 results per page. Deep pagination works but respect the total counts the API returns.
- Some listings do not disclose salary (`Competitive`) or degree class. Those fields will be null.
- Visa sponsorship is inferred from listing prose. When the employer does not mention sponsorship either way, the field is null (not false).
- Scheme size and duration are extracted from free text when present. Not every listing states them.
- The `sector` field is derived from the job title when Prospects.ac.uk does not classify it on the detail page. Accuracy is high for common sector keywords, lower for unusual role titles.
- When `includeCompanyDetails=true`, each unique employer profile is fetched once per run (deduplicated by employer slug + tnr). Prospects.ac.uk rarely publishes phone or email on the employer profile page; expect those fields to be null for most rows. Address and about-us text fill at high rates.
